explication: SigNoz is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform. Its principal workflow is to send application and infrastructure telemetry into SigNoz, then query and correlate signals to investigate issues through dashboards and alerts. The graph preserves the README’s major product capabilities and includes the sampled log-pipeline configuration layer. Several implementation paths are represented only by the repository tree or README; those relationships are documented rather than inferred from unsampled code.
